```yaml
name: Community PR Permissions Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if PR author has write permissions
        id: check-permissions
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const prAuthor = context.payload.pull_request.user.login;
            
            try {
              // Check if the PR author has write access to the repository
              const { data: permission } = await github.rest.repos.getCollaboratorPermissionLevel({
                owner,
                repo,
                username: prAuthor
              });
              
              if (permission.permission === 'admin' || permission.permission === 'write') {
                console.log('PR author has write permissions');
                return true;
              } else {
                console.log('PR author does not have write permissions');
                return false;
              }
            } catch (error) {
              console.log('Error checking permissions:', error.message);
              // If we can't determine permissions, default to allowing the check
              return true;
            }

      - name: Fail if PR author doesn't have write permissions
        if: ${{ steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'false' }}
        run: |
          echo "Error: Only users with write permissions can trigger this workflow."
          exit 1

      - name: Validate PR title format
        if: ${{ steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'true' }}
        run: |
          PR_TITLE="${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
          if [[ ! "$PR_TITLE" =~ ^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore)\(.+\):.*$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: PR title must follow conventional commit format"
            echo "Example: feat(source-zendesk-chat): Handle 404 errors for deleted records"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate PR description
        if: ${{ steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'true' }}
        run: |
          PR_DESCRIPTION="${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"
          if [[ -z "$PR_DESCRIPTION" ]]; then
            echo "Error: PR description cannot be empty"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for required sections
          if ! grep -q "## What" <<< "$PR_DESCRIPTION"; then
            echo "Error: PR description must include '## What' section"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if ! grep -q "## How" <<< "$PR_DESCRIPTION"; then
            echo "Error: PR description must include '## How' section"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if ! grep -q "## Review guide" <<< "$PR_DESCRIPTION"; then
            echo "Error: PR description must include '## Review guide' section"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if ! grep -q "## User Impact" <<< "$PR_DESCRIPTION"; then
            echo "Error: PR description must include '## User Impact' section"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate files changed
        if: ${{ steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'true' }}
        run: |
          # Get list of changed files using safer method
          CHANGED_FILES=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --json files --jq '.files[].path')
          
          # Check for required files
          REQUIRED_FILES=("airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml" 
                          "airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/metadata.yaml"
                          "docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat.md"
                          "docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat-migrations.md")
          
          for file in "${REQUIRED_FILES[@]}"; do
            if ! echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "^$file$"; then
              echo "Error: Required file $file was not modified"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
          # Validate specific changes in manifest.yaml
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "manifest.yaml"; then
            MANIFEST_CHANGES=$(git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml)
            if ! echo "$MANIFEST_CHANGES" | grep -q "404.*IGNORE"; then
              echo "Error: manifest.yaml changes must include 404 response filter with IGNORE action"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          
          # Validate version bump in metadata.yaml
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "metadata.yaml"; then
            METADATA_CHANGES=$(git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/metadata.yaml)
            if ! echo "$METADATA_CHANGES" | grep -q "version: 1.2.21"; then
              echo "Error: metadata.yaml must be updated to version 1.2.21"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Validate changelog entry
        if: ${{ steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'true' }}
        run: |
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "zendesk-chat.md"; then
            CHANGELOG_CONTENT=$(cat docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat.md)
            if ! echo "$CHANGELOG_CONTENT" | grep -q "1.2.21"; then
              echo "Error: changelog entry for version 1.2.21 not found in zendesk-chat.md"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Validate migration doc formatting
        if: ${{ steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'true' }}
        run: |
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q "zendesk-chat-migrations.md"; then
            MIGRATION_CONTENT=$(cat docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat-migrations.md)
            # Check for proper header formatting
            if ! echo "$MIGRATION_CONTENT" | grep -q "^#.*Migration"; then
              echo "Error: Migration document header formatting is incorrect"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Approve workflow if all checks pass
        if: ${{ steps.check-permissions.outputs.result == 'true' }}
        run: |
          echo "All validation checks passed. PR is valid for community contribution."
```
